verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.2: On their flags, they will dwell in the houses of their fathers. The children of Israel will dwell around the tent of the Lord.
verses.3: And the camp was set up from the east, with a flag of the Jewish camp. And the leader of the Jews was Nakhshon, son of Immanuel.
verses.4: And their troops and their chariots numbered four hundred and seventy thousand.
verses.5: And over him were appointed Ishsachar and Naashiyah, sons of Ishsachar. Natanel was the son of Tsu’ar.
verses.6: And his armies and his soldiers were four hundred and fifty thousand.
verses.7: Matti Zevulun and Našia, sons of Zevulun, Eliyahu, son of Chelon.
verses.8: And his armies and soldiers numbered seventy-five thousand four hundred.
verses.9: All those who are destined to be stationed in the camp of Judah: there are one thousand, six hundred and forty-four thousand. First, they will be taken away.
verses.10: The banner of Reuben’s tribe shall be raised for their nations. And it shall belong to the descendants of Reuben, Elizur son of Sedeuor.
verses.11: And his armies and troops numbered six hundred and forty-five thousand.
verses.12: And from him came Shemuel, and to the sons of Shemuel was given Shlomo, son of Zuriy-Shadai.
verses.13: And their armies and their troops numbered fifty-five thousand three hundred.
verses.14: And Matti Gad and Naashiya sent their sons to Eliyahu, son of Reuël.
verses.15: And their armies and troops numbered five hundred and forty thousand six hundred.
verses.16: All the prisoners who were taken to Ravan’s camp numbered one hundred and fifty-four thousand four hundred and fifty. Two of them were taken away as prisoners.
verses.17: And they will travel from the camp of the Levites, among the other camps. When they settle there, each person will go to their own place.
verses.18: The banner of Ephraim’s army shall be raised for their sake. May Ephraim’s children live forever, just as Elisa, son of Ammihud, did.
verses.19: And their armies and troops numbered forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.20: And upon him was placed the title “Manasseh”. And Manasseh’s sons were called Gamliel, sons of Pedaazur.
verses.21: And their armies and their troops numbered two hundred and thirty thousand.
verses.22: And from Benyamin, and Nashiya will be the sons of Benyamin. They will be taken away by Gedoniy.
verses.23: And their armies and troops numbered five hundred and thirty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.24: All the soldiers who are stationed at Ephraim’s camp number one thousand. Their height is also one thousand. And fifty-six of them will go with their armies.
verses.25: The banner of Dan’s camp shall be for their armies. And it shall be a sign to the children of Dan, Ahijazer son of Imeshadai.
verses.26: And their armies and their troops numbered two hundred and sixty thousand seven thousand.
verses.27: And upon him were placed the crowns of fire, which belonged to Vashia, son of Achran.
verses.28: And their armies and their troops numbered one, four hundred thousand, and five thousand.
verses.29: And Mattan Naphthali will be the leader of my descendants. Ahira’ ben-Einan will be their king.
verses.30: And their armies and troops numbered three hundred and fifty thousand four thousand.
verses.31: All those who are assigned to camp at Dan will go to their camps, numbering eight hundred and fifty thousand six thousand.
verses.32: These are the commands given by the children of Israel to their fathers. These are all the rules regarding their camps; there were six thousand, three thousand, five hundred and fifty camps.
verses.33: And the Levites did not stand in place among the children of Israel, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.34: And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses. They settled down in their own towns, and each person went back to his own family’s home.
